sample_unit: exam questions, evidence-based questions, and clinical vignettes

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of the LLM versus ophthalmologists on clinical vignettes
links.effect: Ophthalmologists' correct diagnosis rate was 96.1% vs 81.1% for MOPH, described as not statistically significant (p>0.05).
links.quote: In diagnostic accuracy, although the rate of correct diagnosis by ophthalmologists was superior to that by MOPH (96.1% vs 81.1%, p>0.05), the difference was not statistically significant.

unlisted_practices: Developing a domain-specific, Chinese-language ophthalmic LLM using Chinese corpora

screen.reason: Evaluates a domain-specific Chinese ophthalmology LLM (MOPH) against exams, guideline adherence questions, and clinical vignettes compared to doctors, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
